recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a man in mid-century attire standing on concrete steps in front of a modernist building facade featuring dark wood louvers and blue-tinted glass panels. The scene is characterized by sharp shadows, a potted plant in the background, and a mix of formal and casual urban elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned centrally against a grid-like architectural background
Contrast between the organic form of the human figure and the rigid geometry of the building
Integration of hand-drawn display type into the foreground and background planes
Cool blue window tones balancing the warm browns of the wood and clothing
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject
Concrete steps providing a diagonal base for the composition
Dark, horizontal wooden slats on the left side of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a full-length figure, standing slightly right of center, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark jacket and sunglasses serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal of the concrete steps upward to the subject, then moves to the vertical text on the right window, and finally to the large horizontal title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space is provided by the concrete ground at the bottom and the large blue window panes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the wood siding and subject's clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted sky blue in the window glass panels.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/light gray in the concrete steps and ground.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Desaturated, vintage color palette with high tonal contrast between deep shadows and bright sunlight.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy tones and cool blues

letterConstructionRules: Intentional wobbles and 'bouncy' baseline for secondary text
Large, blocky capitals for primary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has a wide, flattened curve
The 'B' has unequal bowls with a larger bottom loop
Lowercase 'from the' is rendered in a casual, connected script
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy blocky display type at the bottom paired with lighter, vertically stacked lettering in the background.

preserve: Heavy weight of the bottom text
Integration of text into the window pane

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, slightly irregular blocky feel of the main title.
Reflects the mid-century hand-painted sign aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1960s style photograph of a man in a dark jacket and sunglasses standing on concrete steps in front of a modernist house. The house has dark wood horizontal slats on the left and blue-tinted glass windows on the right. A potted plant is visible behind him. Bright daylight with sharp shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add heavy, hand-drawn black sans-serif text across the bottom concrete area. Add a second, lighter weight hand-drawn name vertically stacked inside one of the blue window panes on the right.

verificationChecks: Is the bottom text heavy and hand-drawn?
Are the windows a distinct muted blue?
Is the subject standing on concrete steps?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue tint in the glass
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Authentic mid-century film grain and color balance
Tactile, non-digital quality to the typography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text looks painted or drawn, not typed.
Verify the blue windows provide a clear contrast to the brown wood.
Check that the subject's clothing fits the 1960s era.
Confirm the composition uses the steps as a diagonal lead-in.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle architectural portrait with heavy, hand-lettered display type at the base and lighter integrated type within the background geometry, using a desaturated 1960s color palette.
